messages.subject: Longitudinal Data & Growth Curve Models
parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

This seminar offers a comprehensive exploration of key statistical methods for longitudinal data. Longitudinal Data Analysis and Growth Curve Models led by Giorgio Di Gessa (Epidemiology & Public Health, University College London) and Paola Zaninotto (Epidemiology & Public Health, University College London) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar explores mixed models and growth curves, essential tools for understanding longitudinal data by accounting for variability at different levels. Researchers using lavaan in R can apply these techniques to analyze complex longitudinal data, including latent growth curve models, enhancing their analytical capabilities. Mastering these methods will enable more accurate and reliable research findings within your own studies.

Access this seminar online at your convenience and we'd appreciate you sharing this with colleagues and students!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
